summary: Resemble AI's Builder's Grant awards $500–$30,000 in credits (most grants sized to a production proof-of-concept) usable across both voice generation and deepfake detection APIs, for up to 12 months. Open to teams under 50 employees or companies building a voice-enabled product; free-tier users eligible, existing paid customers excluded. One application per company; recipients agree to 12 months of marketing collaboration.
claim_steps: Create a free Resemble account at app.resemble.ai.
Apply at resemble.ai/start/builders-grant-startup-program describing your project and use case.
Applications are reviewed within one business week; credits land in the account within 48 hours of approval.

social_proof.title: Resemble AI Builder's Grant
social_proof.text: Apply for a Builder's Grant and get up to $30,000 in credits. Grants range from $500 to $30,000. Credits expire 12 months or less from grant approval. Not an existing paid Resemble customer. Free tier users are welcome to apply.
